title: A second own_webroot over Akeeba 7.x guard files exits 0, so an import does not die after the access verifier
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/webroot-skipped-dirs.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code, the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines and the result of the case named: "a second run over guard files already there exits 0, whichever rule comes last".
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 11).

The named case is 'ok' (not 'not ok', not '# SKIP'): a second tracy_webroot_restore_skipped_dirs over a webroot whose com_akeeba/backup already holds .htaccess and index.html exits 0, prints nothing, and does not stop a caller running under set -euo pipefail.
evidence: Production 17/11/2026 22:07 UTC: import of logatel.com (label logatel-com-5ab21324) ended failed, exit code 1, log ending at 'installing the signed access verifier' with no error; the site has administrator/components/com_akeeba/backup with .htaccess and index.html written by the first own_webroot call. Red on 8b82f4bc5 test file before the fix line (not ok 4), green with it.
fence: The function's exit status never depends on whether a guard file already existed; only stdout reports what was made.

tests: a second run over guard files already there exits 0, whichever rule comes last
